tool_input.command: S=/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-dev-projects-demo-app/11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/scratchpad; R=example-org/demo-service; mkdir -p $S/triage && cd $S/triage && gh issue list -R $R --state open --limit 100 --json number,title,body,labels > issues.json && jq length issues.json && git clone -q --no-single-branch --depth 20 https://github.com/$R.git repo 2>&1 | tail -2; ls -a repo repo/.claude repo/.claude/prompts 2>&1
tool_input.description: Download issue bodies and shallow-clone the repo to scratchpad
